This video dives into the mechanics of Backpropagation in Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), specifically exploring the concept of Backpropagation Through Time (BPTT). Learn how RNNs handle the flow of gradients over time, allowing the network to learn and optimize for sequential data.
